name: Fee reminder before the due date
audience: Parents of current students
about: A friendly reminder a few days before the fee is due, and a date when the parent will pay.

steps.title: Opening
say: Hello, am I speaking with {name}?
steps.tip: Smile before you speak. Speak slowly.

steps.title: Introduction
say: This is {me} from {institute}.
I am calling about {student}'s fee.
Is this a good time to talk for two minutes?

steps.title: Reminder
say: This is a friendly reminder.
The fee of {amount_due} is due on {due_date}.
Will you be able to pay by then?
steps.tip: Say the amount and the date slowly. Do not rush.

steps.title: Needs more time
say: No problem. Thank you for telling me.
Which date would be possible for you?
steps.tip: Listen first. Do not argue. Any honest date is fine.

steps.title: Will pay on date
say: Thank you. Please tell me the date, and I will note it.
You can pay at the office or online.
steps.tip: Repeat the date and the amount back to them.
check: Write every way to pay that your institute accepts (office counter, UPI, bank transfer, cheque) and the office hours.

steps.title: Says already paid
say: Thank you! I will check this with the accounts office.
If you have the receipt number or the date you paid, please tell me.
steps.tip: Write the receipt number or date in the note.

steps.title: Cannot pay now
say: I understand. I will tell the office.
Thank you for your time, {name}.
steps.tip: Note the reason in their words. Be kind.

steps.title: Wrong person
say: Sorry to trouble you. Have a good day.

steps.title: Call back later
say: No problem. When is a good time to call you back?
steps.tip: Note the day and time they give.

steps.title: Do not call again
say: Sorry for the trouble. We will not call you again.
Have a good day.
steps.tip: Do not argue or ask why.

check: Write your rule for paying in parts (how many parts, by when, who approves), or remove this answer.
pushbacks.label: Can I pay in parts?
pushbacks.answer: Let me check the rule for this with the office, and I will tell you.

pushbacks.label: Please tell me the amount again
pushbacks.answer: Sure. The amount due is {amount_due}, and the due date is {due_date}.

check: Write every way to pay that your institute accepts (office counter, UPI, bank transfer, cheque) and the office hours.
pushbacks.label: Can I pay online?
pushbacks.answer: Yes. You can pay online or at the office. I can send the details on WhatsApp.

check: Confirm the office can share a break-up of the fee.
pushbacks.label: Why is the fee so high?
pushbacks.answer: I understand. I can send you the fee details on WhatsApp, and the accounts office can explain any part of it.

check: Write your late fee rule (amount and the date it starts), or write that there is no late fee.
pushbacks.label: Is there a late fee?
pushbacks.answer: Let me tell you the rule exactly, so there is no confusion.

check: Say how the receipt is given: printed, on WhatsApp or in the app.
pushbacks.label: Will I get a receipt?
pushbacks.answer: Yes. The office gives a receipt for every payment.

check: Write your rule for paying in parts (how many parts, by when, who approves), or remove this answer.

name: Follow-up: says already paid

steps.title: Opening

steps.title: Will pay on date

steps.tip: Smile before you speak. Speak slowly.

steps.title: Introduction
say: This is {me} from {institute}.
I am calling about {student}'s report card.
Is this a good time to talk for two minutes?

steps.title: Invite
say: The class teacher would like to meet you to talk about {student}'s progress and next steps.
We are meeting every parent of the class.
Will you be able to come?
steps.tip: Do not discuss marks on this call. This call is only to book the meeting.
check: Add the meeting days, times and place. Remove "We are meeting every parent" if you invite only some parents.

steps.title: Coming
say: Thank you! We look forward to meeting you.
check: Add what to bring (report card, diary), or remove this note.

steps.title: Maybe
say: No problem. I will send the details on WhatsApp.
Please come if you can.

steps.title: Not coming
say: Thank you for telling me.
If you like, the class teacher can talk with you on the phone instead.

steps.title: Wrong person
say: Sorry to trouble you. Have a good day.

steps.title: Call back later
say: No problem. When is a good time to call you back?
steps.tip: Note the day and time they give.

steps.title: Do not call again
say: Sorry for the trouble. We will not call you again.
Have a good day.
steps.tip: Do not argue or ask why.

check: Remove "This meeting is for every parent" if you invite only some parents.
pushbacks.label: Is my child doing badly?
pushbacks.answer: This meeting is for every parent. The teacher will share how {student} is doing and answer your questions.

pushbacks.label: Can you tell me the marks now?
pushbacks.answer: I do not have the marks with me. The teacher will go through them with you at the meeting.

check: Write whether other days are possible.
pushbacks.label: Can we meet another day?
pushbacks.answer: Let me check another day with the class teacher and tell you.

pushbacks.label: Can I talk on the phone instead?
pushbacks.answer: Yes. I can ask the teacher to call you at a good time. When suits you?

check: Write how report cards are given (at the meeting, app, sent home).
pushbacks.label: Will we get the report card?
pushbacks.answer: Let me tell you how the report card is given.

name: Fee reminder before the due date (Hinglish)
audience: Parents of current students
about: Hinglish version of "Fee reminder before the due date": a friendly reminder and a date when the parent will pay.

steps.title: Opening
say: Namaste, kya meri baat {name} ji se ho rahi hai?
steps.tip: Smile before you speak. Speak slowly.

steps.title: Introduction
say: Main {me}, {institute} se.
{student} ki fees ke baare mein call kiya hai.
Kya abhi do minute baat ho sakti hai?

steps.title: Reminder
say: Bas ek chhota sa reminder hai.
{amount_due} ki fees {due_date} tak jama karni hai.
Kya tab tak jama ho jayegi?
steps.tip: Say the amount and the date slowly. Do not rush.

steps.title: Needs more time
say: Koi baat nahi, batane ke liye shukriya.
Aapke liye kaun si date theek rahegi?
steps.tip: Listen first. Do not argue. Any honest date is fine.

steps.title: Will pay on date
say: Shukriya. Date bata dijiye, hum note kar lete hain.
Fees office mein ya online jama ho sakti hai.
steps.tip: Repeat the date and the amount back to them.
check: Write every way to pay that your institute accepts (office counter, UPI, bank transfer, cheque) and the office hours, in Hinglish.

steps.title: Says already paid
say: Bahut shukriya! Hum accounts office se check kar lete hain.
Receipt number ya jama karne ki date ho, to bata dijiye.
steps.tip: Write the receipt number or date in the note.

steps.title: Cannot pay now
say: Hum samajh sakte hain. Office ko bata dete hain.
Aapke time ke liye shukriya, {name} ji.
steps.tip: Note the reason in their words. Be kind.

steps.title: Wrong person
say: Maaf kijiye, pareshani ke liye sorry. Aapka din achha ho.

steps.title: Call back later
say: Koi baat nahi. Aapko kab call karna theek rahega?
steps.tip: Note the day and time they give.

steps.title: Do not call again
say: Pareshani ke liye maaf kijiye. Hum aapko dobara call nahi karenge.
Aapka din achha ho.
steps.tip: Do not argue or ask why.

check: Write your rule for paying in parts (how many parts, by when, who approves), in Hinglish, or remove this answer.
pushbacks.label: Kya fees kishton mein de sakte hain?
pushbacks.answer: Iske liye office ka rule check karke aapko batate hain.

pushbacks.label: Amount phir se bata dijiye
pushbacks.answer: Ji zaroor. {amount_due} jama karne hain, {due_date} tak.

check: Write every way to pay that your institute accepts (office counter, UPI, bank transfer, cheque) and the office hours, in Hinglish.
pushbacks.label: Online de sakte hain?
pushbacks.answer: Ji haan, online bhi de sakte hain aur office mein bhi. Details WhatsApp par bhej dete hain.

check: Confirm the office can share a break-up of the fee.
pushbacks.label: Fees itni zyada kyun hai?
pushbacks.answer: Hum samajhte hain. Fees ki poori details WhatsApp par bhej dete hain, aur accounts office har cheez samjha dega.

check: Write your late fee rule (amount and the date it starts) in Hinglish, or write that there is no late fee.
pushbacks.label: Late fee lagegi kya?
pushbacks.answer: Rule aapko theek se batate hain, taaki koi confusion na ho.

name: Overdue fee reminder (Hinglish)
audience: Parents whose fee is past the due date
about: Hinglish version of "Overdue fee reminder": a calm call to get a date for a fee past its due date.

say: Namaste, kya meri baat {name} ji se ho rahi hai?

steps.title: Introduction

steps.title: Fee pending

Abhi tak jama nahi hui hai. Kabhi kabhi reh jaata hai.
Aap kab tak jama kar payenge?
steps.tip: Speak calmly. Many parents simply forgot.

steps.title: Has a problem
say: Hum samajh sakte hain. Batane ke liye shukriya.
Kya abhi thoda aur baaki baad mein dene se madad hogi?
steps.tip: Listen first. Do not argue. Never talk about the child in a bad way.
check: Write your rule for paying in parts (how many parts, by when, who approves), in Hinglish, or remove the second line.

steps.title: Will pay on date

Fees office mein ya online jama ho sakti hai.
steps.tip: Repeat the date and the amount back to them.

steps.title: Says already paid
say: Shukriya, aur pareshani ke liye sorry. Hum accounts office se check kar lete hain.
Receipt number ya jama karne ki date ho, to bata dijiye.
steps.tip: Write the receipt number or date in the note.

steps.title: Cannot pay now
say: Hum samajh sakte hain. Office ko bata dete hain, woh aapse baat karenge.
Aapke time ke liye shukriya, {name} ji.
steps.tip: Note the reason in their words. Be kind.

steps.title: Wrong person
say: Maaf kijiye, pareshani ke liye sorry. Aapka din achha ho.

steps.title: Call back later
say: Koi baat nahi. Aapko kab call karna theek rahega?
steps.tip: Note the day and time they give.

steps.title: Do not call again
say: Pareshani ke liye maaf kijiye. Hum aapko dobara call nahi karenge.
Aapka din achha ho.
steps.tip: Do not argue or ask why.

pushbacks.label: Sorry, bhool gaye the
pushbacks.answer: Koi baat nahi, ho jaata hai. Aapke liye kaun si date theek rahegi?

pushbacks.label: Is mahine paise ki dikkat hai
pushbacks.answer: Hum samajhte hain. Jo date aapke liye theek ho, bata dijiye, hum note kar lete hain.

check: Write your rule for paying in parts (how many parts, by when, who approves), in Hinglish, or remove this answer.
pushbacks.label: Kishton mein de sakte hain?
pushbacks.answer: Iske liye office ka rule check karke aapko batate hain.

check: Write who decides on late fee waivers, in Hinglish, or remove this answer if there is no late fee.
pushbacks.label: Late fee maaf ho sakti hai?
pushbacks.answer: Yeh hum khud tay nahi kar sakte. Aapki request office tak pahuncha dete hain, woh aapko batayenge.

pushbacks.label: Phir se call kyun kiya?
pushbacks.answer: Dobara call ke liye maaf kijiye. Record mein fees abhi bhi baaki dikh rahi hai. Agar jama kar di hai, to date bata dijiye, hum match kar lenge.

pushbacks.label: School aakar jama kar denge
pushbacks.answer: Theek hai ji. Kis din aayenge? Hum note kar lete hain.

name: School admission enquiry follow-up (Hinglish)
audience: Parents who enquired about admission for a class
about: Hinglish version of "School admission enquiry follow-up": book a school visit or send the form.

steps.title: Opening
say: Namaste, kya meri baat {name} ji se ho rahi hai?
steps.tip: Smile before you speak. Speak slowly.

steps.title: Introduction
say: Main {me}, {institute} se.
Aapne {class} class mein admission ke baare mein poocha tha, uske liye shukriya.
Kya abhi do minute baat ho sakti hai?

steps.title: What they need
say: Kya aap abhi bhi bachche ke liye school dekh rahe hain?
Naye school mein aapke liye sabse zaroori kya hai?
steps.tip: Listen. Note what matters to them: distance, teachers, fees, board, activities.

steps.title: Visit or form
say: Sabse achha hai ki aap ek baar school dekh lein aur teachers se mil lein.
Kya aap visit karna chahenge? Admission form WhatsApp par bhi bhej sakte hain.
check: Add your visiting days, hours and address in Hinglish, the way callers should say them.

steps.title: Visit booked
say: Bahut badhiya! Kaun sa din aur time theek rahega?
Address aur location WhatsApp par bhej dete hain. Milte hain, {name} ji.
steps.tip: Note the date. Repeat it back.

steps.title: Form sent
say: Ji zaroor. Admission form abhi WhatsApp par bhej rahe hain.
Koi bhi sawaal ho, to call kar lijiye.

steps.title: Not looking now
say: Koi baat nahi. Aapke time ke liye shukriya, {name} ji.
Bachche ko all the best.
steps.tip: If they joined another school, choose Joined elsewhere instead.

steps.title: Wrong person
say: Maaf kijiye, pareshani ke liye sorry. Aapka din achha ho.

steps.title: Call back later
say: Koi baat nahi. Aapko kab call karna theek rahega?
steps.tip: Note the day and time they give.

steps.title: Do not call again
say: Pareshani ke liye maaf kijiye. Hum aapko dobara call nahi karenge.
Aapka din achha ho.
steps.tip: Do not argue or ask why.

check: Confirm the campaign's board tag is your school's board, or write the board here.
pushbacks.label: School kaun se board ka hai?
pushbacks.answer: Hamara school {board} board ka hai.

check: Add your school timings by class, in Hinglish.
pushbacks.label: School ki timing kya hai?
pushbacks.answer: {class} class ki timing aapko batate hain.

check: Write whether you have a bus and which areas it covers, in Hinglish.
pushbacks.label: School bus hai kya?
pushbacks.answer: Bus ke routes aapko batate hain, WhatsApp par bhi bhej sakte hain.

check: Write if seats are open. Never say seats are almost full unless it is true.
pushbacks.label: Seat khaali hai kya?
pushbacks.answer: {class} class ki seats office se check karke aapko sahi batate hain.

check: Write the list of documents, or confirm it is sent with the form.
pushbacks.label: Kaun se documents chahiye?
pushbacks.answer: Documents ki list form ke saath WhatsApp par bhej dete hain.

name: Cold call, bought or shared list (Hinglish)
audience: People on a contact list who never asked us to call
about: Hinglish version of "Cold call (bought or shared list)": honest, permission first, easy to say no.

steps.title: Opening
say: Namaste, kya meri baat {name} ji se ho rahi hai?
steps.tip: Smile before you speak. Speak slowly.

steps.title: Honest introduction
say: Main {me}, {institute} se.
Yeh hamare {course} course ke baare mein ek sales call hai.
Kya ek minute baat ho sakti hai?
steps.tip: Be honest and short. If they say no, thank them and end the call.

steps.title: Are they looking?
say: Shukriya. Kya aap ya aapke ghar mein koi abhi {course} seekhna chahta hai?

steps.title: Where the number came from
say: Aapka number hamein {source} se mila hai.
Agar aap call nahi chahte, to hum abhi band kar dete hain.
steps.tip: Never guess or hide where the number came from.

steps.title: Short pitch
say: Short mein, {institute} mein {course} sikhaya jaata hai.
Kya details WhatsApp par bhej dein?
steps.tip: Send on WhatsApp only if they say yes.
check: Add 2 short lines in Hinglish: what the course is, who it is for, online or in class. No promises of jobs, marks or ranks.

steps.title: Interested
say: Shukriya! Details abhi WhatsApp par bhej rahe hain.
Dekhne ke baad ek baar call kar sakte hain?

steps.title: Not interested
say: Koi baat nahi. Aapke time ke liye shukriya.
Aapka din achha ho.
steps.tip: If they ask not to be called again, choose Do not call again.

steps.title: Wrong person
say: Maaf kijiye, pareshani ke liye sorry. Aapka din achha ho.

steps.title: Call back later
say: Koi baat nahi. Aapko kab call karna theek rahega?
steps.tip: Note the day and time they give.

steps.title: Do not call again
say: Pareshani ke liye maaf kijiye. Hum aapko dobara call nahi karenge.
Aapka din achha ho.
steps.tip: Do not argue or ask why.

pushbacks.label: Mujhe interest nahi hai
pushbacks.answer: Koi baat nahi. Aapke time ke liye shukriya. Kya hum is number par call karna band kar dein?

pushbacks.label: Mera naam kahan se mila?
pushbacks.answer: Aapka naam aur number {source} se mila hai. Aap chahein to dono abhi list se hata dete hain.

pushbacks.label: Aapko hi kyun chunein?
pushbacks.answer: Achha sawaal hai. Details WhatsApp par bhej dete hain, aap aaram se compare karke decide kijiye.

check: Add your website address, or remove the website part.
pushbacks.label: Kuch likh kar bhejo
pushbacks.answer: Ji zaroor. Details WhatsApp par bhej dete hain, aur aap hamari website bhi dekh sakte hain.

check: Write whether classes are online, in class or both, in Hinglish.
pushbacks.label: Online hai ya class mein?
pushbacks.answer: Classes kaise chalti hain, woh aapko batate hain.
